title: Smart Data Models - Madrid Traffic Accidents - AccidentInvolvedPerson
description: A record of one person involved in a traffic accident in the City of Madrid, as registered by the Policia Municipal (drivers, passengers, pedestrians, witnesses). The source dataset publishes one row per involved person, not per accident -- accident-level fields (location, weather, type, coordinates) are repeated identically across every person in the same accident, which this candidate's entity design mirrors faithfully. Source: 'Accidentes de Trafico de la Ciudad de Madrid', Direccion General de la Policia Municipal, version November 2023.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AccidentInvolvedPerson'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

numExpediente.description: Property. Case file number, format AAAASNNNNNN where AAAA is the accident year and S denotes a case with an accident (num_expediente in the source). Shared by every person involved in the same accident -- use this to group rows into a single accident if needed.

fecha.description: Property. Date of the accident (fecha in the source). Source format is dd/mm/aaaa; converted to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here.

hora.description: Property. Time of the accident (hora in the source), as recorded verbatim -- H:MM:SS, not zero-padded. NOTE: the source PDF specification states hour values are bucketed into 1-hour ranges, but the real published CSV data has full minute-level precision; this candidate follows the real data.

localizacion.description: Property. Location description: 'calle 1 - calle 2' for an intersection, or a single street (localizacion in the source).

numero.description: Property. Street number, when meaningful for the location (numero in the source). Kept as a string since it is sometimes absent for intersections.

codDistrito.description: Property. District code, 1-21 (cod_distrito in the source).

distrito.description: Property. District name (distrito in the source).

tipoAccidente.description: Property. Type of accident (tipo_accidente in the source). NOTE: the source PDF describes 8 broad categories in prose (e.g. grouping frontal/fronto-lateral/lateral collisions under one 'Colision doble' heading), but the real published data records 13 more granular values; this candidate enumerates the values actually observed in the real data.

estadoMeteorologico.description: Property. Weather conditions at the time of the accident (estado_meteorologico in the source; the source CSV header itself carries an accent -- 'meteorológico' -- not present in the source PDF specification). Includes the literal value 'NULL' and the inconsistently-capitalised 'LLuvia intensa', preserved exactly as they appear in the real published data.

tipoVehiculo.description: Property. Type of vehicle involved (tipo_vehiculo in the source). Enumerates all 35 distinct values observed in the real published data, including the literal value 'NULL' (used e.g. for pedestrians, who are not associated with a vehicle).

tipoPersona.description: Property. Role of the person in the accident (tipo_persona in the source): driver, passenger or pedestrian.

rangoEdad.description: Property. Age bracket of the affected person (rango_edad in the source).

sexo.description: Property. Sex of the affected person (sexo in the source). NOTE: the source PDF specification states the possible values are 'hombre, Mujer o no asignado', but the real published data uses 'Desconocido' rather than 'no asignado'; this candidate follows the real data.

codLesividad.description: Property. Injury severity code (cod_lesividad in the source; see the source PDF for the full code table). Kept as a string enum rather than a number because the real published data uses the literal value 'NULL' for the majority of rows (no assessed injury), which the source PDF describes as occurring on a blank line instead -- this candidate follows the real data.

enum: Asistencia sanitaria inmediata en centro de salud o mutua
Asistencia sanitaria sólo en el lugar del accidente
Atención en urgencias sin posterior ingreso
Ingreso inferior o igual a 24 horas
lesividad.description: Property. Injury severity description, corresponding to codLesividad (lesividad in the source).

coordenadaXUtm.description: Property. X coordinate of the accident location, in the ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N projected coordinate system (coordenada_x_utm in the source; not WGS84 -- no verified reprojection was available at translation time, see standard-metadata.yaml).

coordenadaYUtm.description: Property. Y coordinate of the accident location, in the ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N projected coordinate system (Coordenada_y_utm in the source, capitalised inconsistently there).

positivaAlcohol.description: Property. Whether the person tested positive for alcohol (positiva_alcohol in the source). Includes the literal value 'NULL' observed in the real data, in addition to the 'N'/'S' values described in the source PDF.

positivaDroga.description: Property. Whether the person tested positive for drugs (positiva_droga in the source): the literal string 'NULL', or '1' if positive.
